description: This PHP source file defines the 'GroupField' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. The class maps to the 'ohrm_group_field' database table and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping. It contains properties such as id, name, groupByClause, and an optional groupFieldWidget, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: GroupField
classes.description: Entity class representing a group field with properties for id, name, groupByClause, and optional groupFieldWidget, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_group_field'.
